question: Calculate Apple's compound annual revenue growth rate from 2022 to 2025.
generated_sql: WITH apple_revenue AS (SELECT fiscal_year, metric_value FROM analytics.company_financial_metrics WHERE company_name = 'Apple' AND fiscal_year IN (2022, 2025) AND fiscal_period = 'FY' AND metric_name = 'revenue' ORDER BY fiscal_year) SELECT ROUND(POWER(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2025 THEN metric_value END) / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2022 THEN metric_value END), 1.0 / 3.0) - 1, 4) AS "cagr_2022_to_2025" FROM apple_revenue;
